articles.title: Zano rolls blockchain back a month after Gateway Address exploit
articles.snippet: The Zano blockchain has been restarted at the block height that came immediately before Hard Fork 6, which introduced Gateway Addresses.

articles.title: KelpDAO sues LayerZero, CEO over $292M rsETH bridge exploit
articles.snippet: KelpDAO says LayerZero endorsed its bridge setup before the attack, while CEO Bryan Pellegrino has dismissed the lawsuit as meritless.

articles.title: Circle and Tether Freeze Stablecoins Tied to Bitget Hack—But Most Funds Slip Away
articles.snippet: The two stablecoin issuers blacklisted a wallet labeled "Bitget Exploiter 8," locking about $318,000 in USDC and USDT—but the attacker swapped most funds into unfreezable ETH before they could act.

articles.title: Magic Eden Warns Old Ethereum NFT Listings Are Exposed to Payment Processor Exploit
articles.snippet: A flaw in Limit Break's Payment Processor V2 put old Magic Eden Ethereum listings at risk, prompting a whitehat rescue of more than 23,000 NFTs.

articles.title: KelpDAO Developer Sues LayerZero Over $292M Bridge Exploit
articles.snippet: Evercrest says LayerZero approved the single-verifier configuration in writing multiple times, then warned a different developer about it.
